'''Darth Hoth The Empire's Deal With Scum''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Darth Hoth]]
* '''Published:''' 4 December 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Theme/Fun
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 Deal Hoth DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Dark Deal deck using Imperials and Bounty Hunters to get some high damage going.

The published list has 62 cards.

== Strategy ==

First I want to thank icebreath for the inspiration for the space package.

first action: Use Mobilization Points combo to pull Executor. For the second action, pull the Interrogation Room and Upper Plaza Corridor.

first turn: activation-3. Use the objective to pull Bespin. If you see TMNALTC, use We're The Bait(V) to pull it. Deploy Executor for free using it. Deploy the two sites.

The rest of the game is pretty much spent just setting up and then holding Dark Deal and Occupation.

a few card choices:

Interrogaion Array-good for direct damage

Mandalorian Armor-put it on Lando to keep him hanging around

OS-72-10-great when on Obsidian 10

All Too Easy-I have 3 sabers, might as well use them and freeze someone to get the force loss from PIDAIAF

Vader's Bounty(V)-Fett and Vader are great together and adds to Fett's weapon destiny

Interrogation Room-even more direct damage

Obsidians-hold Cloud City very well

Mist Hunter(V)-reduce opponent's destiny draws

Vengeance-just in case I need to move the TIEs to Bespin

Thanks for looking, and, hopefully, reviewing.
